message.content: Dark mode looks awful: the panels glare and half the labels vanish.

content.text: Forty screens hard-code a hex value, so nothing changes with the appearance. The cure is **semantic tokens**: a screen asks for `surface` or `ink-muted`, and each theme says what those mean.

message.content: Do it, and make the old way impossible to bring back.

content.text: All forty are moved over, and a lint now refuses any hex literal outside `styles/themes/`, so a raw colour in a screen fails the build.
